_note: P1 sports coupe mod tree (step T1, 2026-10-10). Shared spine: Service, then a fork of engine identities (A stays naturally aspirated, B takes boost), one deeper step under each (L2), then a Grip or Slide capstone that fits any L2: 8 finished builds. Templates are in _templates.json; ops here replace the template's op on the same path. Numbers are starting values for the feel test. Prices are guesses in nights, times the car's tier factor (_shared.json).

builds._note: The tier each L2 build reaches with everything fitted (capstone, side nodes, every bolt-on, top parts). Checked by the test from the build's own Nm per kg. Only B1, the big single, may pass the T4 ceiling (_shared.json t5_builds).

nodes.name: Service
nodes.feel: Fresh plugs, no leaks. It pulls clean again.

nodes.name: Stay NA
nodes.feel: Cams and an open intake. Sharper, and 500 more revs.

nodes.name: Small turbo
nodes.feel: Soft below 2,800, then a clean shove.

nodes.name: Screamer
nodes.feel: Revs to 9,000 and wants to live there.

nodes.name: Stroker
nodes.feel: Big torque low down. Lazy near the top.

nodes.name: Big single turbo
nodes.feel: Nothing till 4,000, then a wall of it.

nodes.name: Twin-scroll pair
nodes.feel: Boost from low revs. A flat, wide pull.

nodes.name: Grip
nodes.feel: Planted. A wing that works; it goes where you point it.

nodes.name: Slide
nodes.feel: Loose on purpose. The back steps out and stays out.

side.name: Fixed lamps
side.feel: The pop-ups go. Less to push through the air.

side.name: Intake trumpets
side.feel: Six open throats. You hear every one.
